topic: Medical expense tax credit: expenses above the lesser of 3% of net income or $2,834 (2025); either spouse may claim the family's line 33099 expenses; non-refundable

example.note: example (not a CRA rule): couple, net incomes $90,000 and $30,000, $3,500 of eligible expenses for themselves (line 33099), 2025, federal credit at 14.5%; Sam's federal tax before credits ≈ ($30,000 − $16,129) × 14.5% ≈ $2,011, enough to absorb $377; provincial credits not included.

spoken.cap: two thousand eight hundred and thirty-four dollars

sources.threshold: canada.ca Budget 2025 – CRA information on select measures: METC on eligible expenses above the lesser of $2,834 (2025) and 3% of net income; lines 33099 / 33199 (via search 2026-10-25)
sources.who: CRA line 33099: expenses for you, your spouse/common-law partner and children under 18 can be claimed by either spouse
sources.rate: 2025 lowest federal rate 14.5%; 2025 BPA $16,129 (CRA What's new for 2025)
